name: Garuda Construction and Engineering Ltd
tagline: Mumbai-region civil construction/EPC company posting exceptional headline return ratios (ROCE ~41.8%), triple-digit revenue growth and a cheap ~12x P/E, backed by a genuinely large (~Rs 4,877 Cr) named order book - but this pass found a fresh, dated promoter share pledge (Jul 2026, Rs 50 Cr for company working capital) alongside a secretarial-auditor resignation/replacement (May 2026), a severe FY25 cash-flow crisis (operating cash flow -Rs 111 Cr against Rs 50 Cr profit), and steadily declining FII holdings.
business_overview: Garuda Construction and Engineering Ltd was incorporated in 2010 and is primarily engaged in civil construction/EPC services, concentrated in the Mumbai region including redevelopment-style projects (e.g. Shikhar-B/Oshiwara Rs 143.96 Cr, Chandivali rehabilitation Rs 231 Cr, and the large Rs 1,416 Cr 'Powai Heights' luxury-residential EPC contract from Sumer Corporation, 60-month completion). Promoter group is PKH Ventures Limited (67.56% holding). Listed via IPO (2024/2025 era). FY26 standalone net profit rose to ~Rs 106-123 Cr (sources vary, likely a standalone/consolidated difference) from ~Rs 50 Cr in FY25, with revenue from operations scaling to ~Rs 463-534 Cr.
fundamentals_table: ~12.0x trailing (down from ~13.3x at original discovery as the price has pulled back from its high)
FY26 revenue +137% YoY (Rs 534 Cr); FY26 PAT ~2.1-2.5x FY25 (Rs 106-123 Cr vs ~Rs 50 Cr); Q1 FY27 PAT +48% YoY (Rs 41.5 Cr vs Rs 28 Cr)
~Rs 4,877 Cr (Q4 FY26) / ~Rs 4,337 Cr (Dec 2025 snapshot) - roughly ~9x FY26 revenue, multi-year (36-60 month) execution on named large contracts
Near debt-free: Rs 0 Cr borrowings (Mar 2025) -> Rs 12 Cr (Mar 2026)
FY25 operating cash flow -Rs 111 Cr against Rs 50 Cr profit (severe divergence); FY26 improved to +Rs 41 Cr OCF against Rs 106-123 Cr profit (still well below reported profit)
Debtor days improved from 292 to 165 (still elevated; historically as high as 417 in FY24, up from 143 in FY22); working-capital days 220 (Mar 2026)
PKH Ventures pledged 65 lakh shares (6.99% of total equity, 13.51% of promoter's stake) on Jul 31, 2026 to Aditya Birla Capital, securing Rs 50 Cr for company working capital (security cover 2.2:1)
fundamentals_narrative: The headline growth and return-ratio story remains genuinely impressive: ROCE ~41.8%, near-zero leverage, a ~12x trailing P/E against triple-digit recent growth, and a large, named, multi-year order book (~Rs 4,877 Cr, ~9x FY26 revenue) spanning real Mumbai redevelopment/EPC contracts (Shikhar-B, Chandivali, the Rs 1,416 Cr Powai Heights deal with Sumer Corporation). However, this deep-dive pass surfaces a materially more cautious picture than the original light pass (which deferred the forum thread read and found 'no red flags'): (1) FY25 operating cash flow was severely negative (-Rs 111 Cr) against a positive Rs 50 Cr profit - construction/EPC working-capital and percentage-of-completion accounting can genuinely diverge from cash for a period, but this is an extreme divergence; (2) debtor days have historically been very high (peaking at 417 in FY24, up from 143 in FY22), improving to 165-292 more recently but still elevated, with working-capital days at 220 as of Mar 2026; (3) on July 31, 2026, promoter entity PKH Ventures pledged 65 lakh shares (6.99% of total equity, 13.51% of its own stake) to Aditya Birla Capital specifically to secure Rs 50 Cr of financing for the COMPANY's working capital - a fresh, dated, concrete promoter-pledge event, not a forum caution on paper; (4) a secretarial auditor was both appointed and resigned/replaced on May 30, 2026 (an auditor-change event, though the secretarial - not statutory - auditor, and no detail found on whether this was routine rotation or something more); and (5) FII holdings have been steadily declining (6.65% to 2.63% over 18 months) even as the headline growth numbers have accelerated - informed institutional money reducing exposure alongside the operational picture above.
technical_read: Trades at ~Rs 176, off its 52-week high (~Rs 249) and below the ~Rs 194 level at original discovery - a real pullback, plausibly reflecting the market partially digesting the pledge/FII-selling news above.

No SEBI enforcement action or litigation was found against the company itself this pass.

Genuinely large, real, named multi-year order book (~Rs 4,877 Cr, ~9x FY26 revenue) across real Mumbai EPC/redevelopment contracts with 36-60 month execution windows
Cheap valuation relative to growth: ~12x trailing P/E against 137% FY26 revenue growth and continued Q1 FY27 momentum (PAT +48% YoY)

bear_case: CONFIRMED, dated promoter pledge: PKH Ventures pledged 65 lakh shares (6.99% of equity) on Jul 31, 2026 specifically to fund the COMPANY's working capital - a real, concrete signal of balance-sheet strain, not just a forum caution
A secretarial auditor was appointed and resigned/replaced (May 30, 2026) - an auditor-change event in the same window as the pledge

FY25 operating cash flow was severely negative (-Rs 111 Cr) against Rs 50 Cr reported profit, and even FY26's improved OCF (+Rs 41 Cr) remains well below the Rs 106-123 Cr reported PAT - construction/EPC accounting can explain some of this, but the scale of the divergence is a real quality-of-earnings question
Debtor days have historically been extreme (peaking at 417 in FY24) and remain elevated (165-292, working-capital days 220) even after improvement

verdict_headline: A real, large order book and exceptional headline return ratios - but this pass found a fresh, dated promoter pledge for working capital, a secretarial-auditor change, a severe FY25 cash-flow crisis and declining FII holdings, none of which the original light pass (which deferred the forum thread and found 'no red flags') checked for. HIGH CAUTION set; conviction downgraded to Low-Medium; thesis 'neither' pending resolution of the cash-flow and pledge situation.
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive pass 1 found what the original pass, which explicitly deferred both the forum thread and any BSE/SEBI filing check, did not surface: a promoter share pledge (PKH Ventures, Jul 31, 2026, Rs 50 Cr for company working capital) and a secretarial-auditor resignation/replacement (May 30, 2026) - both dated, concrete, sourced facts, not forum speculation.

HIGH CAUTION set per protocol: a promoter pledge tied explicitly to the listed company's own working-capital shortfall is at least as serious a signal as the 'promoter-holding collapse' trigger (it creates real forced-sale/margin-call risk and confirms balance-sheet strain), compounded by the auditor-change event and a severe, sourced FY25 operating-cash-flow/profit divergence (-Rs 111 Cr OCF vs +Rs 50 Cr profit).

The underlying business (order book, ROCE, revenue growth) remains genuinely strong and the pledge's security cover (2.2:1) is not distress-level thin - this is a real caution, not necessarily a fraud pattern, but it is exactly the kind of finding a 'no red flags' light pass should not have missed.
